title: Draw & Guess
tagline: Draw with friends and race an AI that must prove its guess with video.
description: Build a multiplayer drawing game with Agora Interactive Whiteboard, RTC voice chat and proof-video sharing, and RTM room updates. An optional FastH3 challenger must guess the sketch, generate matching video, and pass independent vision verification before it wins.
author: zicojiao

media.title: Draw & Guess
media.summary: Draw and guess with friends using Agora Whiteboard and voice chat. Race FastH3 as it turns a correct guess into verified video proof.
